articles.title: Democrats’ ‘climate hushing’ prompts activists to turn up the volume
articles.description:

This summer, torrential rains have washed away Texas neighborhoods, dangerous heat has blanketed swaths of the country, and smoke from Canadian wildfires has choked communities as far south as Florida.

articles.title: Purple reign: how shade became British gardeners’ favourite
articles.description:
Britons move away from trend of grey paving and pristine lawns in an embrace of colour, with lavender a top choice

If you manage to spot a garden in bloom this summer, beyond the strips of bleached and torched grass, there may be one colour you see more than any other: purple, the horticultural hue of the season.

Plants such as lavender, salvias and catmint are in vogue, according to the Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), which conducted extensive research into the colours Britons best love to see in their gardens.

articles.title: India’s monsoon rains in danger as UN chief warns planet is ‘on fire’
articles.description:
António Guterres says strengthening El Niño will help push the world’s climate crisis into ‘uncharted territory’

India’s monsoon is in danger and hotter, drier conditions are forecast across much of the world as a stronger El Niño weather system is taking hold, weather experts have warned.

António Guterres, the UN secretary general, said the strengthening El Niño was “adding fuel to a planet already on fire” and pushing the world into “uncharted territory”.

articles.title: More deaths and injuries in major Russian attacks on Ukraine as Poland investigates airspace violation – Europe live
articles.description:
Huge missile and drone attack on Ukraine as Poland’s Tusk prepares to travel to impact site discovered in east of country

We are getting some first pictures from the site of the incident in Poland, via Poland’s state broadcaster TVP Info.

Estonian president Alar Karis warned that Russia’s war “continues to endanger lives far beyond Ukraine,” as he expressed his nation’s solidarity with Ukraine and Poland.

“Another night of Russian attacks. Civilians killed, including children. Homes destroyed. Cities across Ukraine set ablaze. Now a reported explosion & debris on NATO territory in Poland.

Russia’s war continues to endanger lives far beyond Ukraine. We stand with Poland & Ukraine.”

articles.title: Black people’s risk factors for stroke ‘rising faster than for white people’
articles.description:
Exclusive: King’s College London analysis finds diabetes and hypertension are more common in Black African and Caribbean people

Stroke risk factors including high blood pressure and diabetes are rising faster among people from Black African and Caribbean backgrounds compared with their white counterparts, according to analysis.

Researchers at King’s College London analysed data from more than 8,500 adults over a 30-year period from the South London Stroke Register, one of the longest-running population-based stroke registers in the world.
